name: Ira
source:
"...you know how miserable poverty is! I want to win at life!"

A strong-willed and active girl who knows how to navigate the world. Because she lost her parents, she now lives alone. From her poor life so far, she knows the weakness and misery of not having money, so she is determined to save money and rise to the upper class. What she likes is money, and what she hates is poverty. Her hobby is saving money, and she works hard every day to earn coins.

[Translated from [url=https://www.vridge.co.jp/homepage/contents/products/eg/chara_1.htm]official website[/url]]
